prompt:
Create ONE design variant sheet for a prop of a silent hand-drawn animated film. Pure black field (#000000), flat shapes in five roles only (main1, main2, shadow, light, accent), thin pale contour one step lighter than each fill with tapered tips, shadow as a designed shape with two-scale stipple (never a smooth gradient), no text, no labels, no UI, no gradients, no photographic texture, no black outline. Colour script of the shot: deep blues with cream light and one scarce yellow accent #fad204 (radiance blue #0a51fb). The design must separate into movable parts on the black field (each part a closed flat shape) so it can be cut and moved later.
ASSET: the piece family the gadget projects, one sheet: a stalk (a prompt: a curling stalk with a flag leaf), a pointed arch (a gate, with a keystone), a ring (a framework: a receding turned frame), a block, a frame (prompt_engine, held up), a soft ground patch and a beaded light string (a chain) joining two stalks; hand-coded today in Pieces.tsx and Frame.tsx.
LAYOUT: Show all seven members at ONE scale on one baseline in one row, the beaded string hanging between two stalks, no overlaps. 16:9 sheet.
REFERENCE ROLES (each image supplies only the property named; do not copy any of them):
Image 1: Dr. Seuss Midnight Painting: swooping organic lobes, curling stalks with flag leaves and pale thin contour on black.
Image 2: Dr. Seuss Midnight Painting: stacked pointed arches in interlocking layered shapes.
Image 3: Dr. Seuss Midnight Painting: receding hand-drawn frames, each slightly turned.
Image 4: owner card MFI6SELJHX04J: height by a single vertical and a flat pattern.
Image 5: the Codex companion: take only its rounded soft cloud-and-prompt silhouette and its screen-glyph window as the cast property.
VARIANT muse-01 'Seuss grammar': Every member in the Seuss grammar: stalks with flag leaves, a stacked pointed arch, a nested turned frame as the ring, beads as the string. The design sits between codex (rounded soft silhouette) and the Seuss paintings.
